description: This file defines a utility enum 'ToolResultTextFormatter' with static methods for formatting and rendering tool result texts, particularly handling JSON data for display purposes in a user interface.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main function to format input text, parses JSON if applicable and delegates to rendering functions.

methods.name: looksLikeJSON
methods.description: Checks whether the input string appears to be JSON based on its first character.

methods.name: renderJSON
methods.description: Renders JSON object into a user-friendly string, handling dictionaries and arrays.

methods.name: renderDictionary
methods.description: Converts a JSON dictionary into a human-readable string, handling status, error, message, and node summaries.

methods.name: renderNodesSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary string for a list of nodes from JSON data.

methods.name: pairingDetail
methods.description: Determines pairing status from node data.

methods.name: firstString
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty string value for given keys in a dictionary.

methods.name: sanitizeError
methods.description: Cleans and truncates raw error messages for display.
